method.latency: One loopback HTTP connection per RPC, including client JSON decoding. p95 uses linear interpolation.
method.startup: Launcher setup through first valid getHealth, with a 50 ms readiness polling interval.
method.loc: cloc over tracked source files including tests, excluding build.sh and run.sh.
method.size: Uncompressed tracked code and runnable binary/module files. Runtime installations and build intermediates are excluded.
method.build: One build.sh invocation from a clean source tree with existing toolchain caches.
method.rss: Peak sampled aggregate process-group RSS via ps at 100 ms intervals plus a post-workload sample. Short-lived peaks can be missed and shared pages can be counted twice.
method.isolation: One implementation at a time. Ambient host activity was not controlled.
method.live: Direct HTTPS. One RPC at a time with a pause before every getBlock. Internal range requests and retries are governed by each implementation.
